name: Pearl
title: Gloom Stalker Ranger
role: The party's archer and opening striker. Gloom Stalker initiative and her extra first-round attack let her shoot first. Titanstring Bow adds the Strength her Club gives her, and Hunter's Mark plus Sharpshooter, offset by Archery and accuracy gear, carry the rest of the fight. Ensnaring Strike, Pass Without Trace and Spike Growth all take her concentration, so they replace Hunter's Mark. The spell lists are a menu: she knows 2 spells at level 2, 4 at level 5 and 6 at level 9.

gear.note: Adds your Strength modifier to damage. The heart of this build. Confirmed in game: it adds the Club's Strength.
STR 19 from the melee slot while you shoot. Check your STR on the character sheet with the bow drawn.
1d10 + 1 and +1 to hit: the hardest-hitting ranged weapon until Titanstring.

Heavy crossbow: ranged hits can Bane the target (Charisma save). Zarys's reward in the same quest as Titanstring, at Waukeen's Rest. Don't make the deal with Rugan to fake the lost shipment: if Zarys finds out, it's gone for good.
+2 damage on ranged weapon attacks.
+1 to attack rolls (and DEX 18 if yours is lower).
+2 acid on every weapon hit, possibly each Arrow of Many Targets hit (check in game).
+1d4 psychic on weapon hits while you concentrate (Hunter's Mark).

+1d6 poison on your weapon, bows included, for 3 turns after you're healed; most self-healing from gear doesn't trigger it, but the Ring of Regeneration does. Your amulet in every act: see Don't miss in Act 1 for getting it from Kagha.

Heals 1d4 at the start of each of your turns in combat, even at full health, which keeps Broodmother's Revenge coating your bow: 1d6 poison on every hit in place of the Caustic Band's 2 acid. Poison-immune enemies shrug that off.
Momentum (extra movement) for 3 turns at the start of combat.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest; immune to webs, grease and ice.
+1 to ranged attack rolls.
Advantage on attacks, Disadvantage on saves: the strongest Sharpshooter fix.

Off hand with the Club (both are Light): each kill gives +1 to attack and damage rolls, up to +3, which offsets Sharpshooter's −5. Costs the shield's +2 AC and +3 initiative. Check in game that bow kills build the stacks and that arrows get the bonus. Drops from Cazador.
+3 initiative and Advantage on Perception. Check in game that a shield's bonuses apply while your bow is drawn.
+1d4 fire on weapon hits.
Bonus action for Advantage on weapon attacks, once per short rest. While it's active, healing spells can't target you (potions still work).
+1 AC.
Crit range −1 and double proficiency on attack rolls. Gives up Titanstring's Strength damage.
+2 to weapon attack and damage rolls. With the Club's +4, that's +6 damage per arrow and +2 to hit. Sold by Dammon at the Forge of the Nine.
+2 to attack rolls, initiative and Perception.
Crit range −1 while Hiding, so mostly for an opening shot from hiding.
16 + full DEX.

14 + full DEX, +2 initiative, Shield once per long rest because of a bug (re-equipping the armour resets it), and Advantage on Stealth. In vault nº9 at the Counting House; the key comes from Return Rakath's Gold.
+2 AC, and 8 temporary HP once per short rest when you take damage below half HP. Check in game that a shield's bonuses apply while your bow is drawn.
+1d4 to attack rolls against your Hunter's Mark target.
Light armour: 12 + full DEX (16 at DEX 18) and +1 Stealth. Her Act 1 armour, from the Underdark.
15 + 2 DEX = 17 AC. The Hollow's copy, on a crate near Dammon, is yours.
14 + full DEX and no Stealth Disadvantage: her Act 2 armour.
+1d4 necrotic on weapon attacks: the same job as Flawed Helldusk Gloves without Infernal Iron. In the Gauntlet of Shar.

Once per long rest because of a bug, take half damage from the next elemental attack and add 1d6 of that element to your next attack. A minor pick: Cloak of Protection is Alene's in Act 2. In an opulent chest in Ketheric Thorm's chambers at Moonrise Towers.

Not for you to wield: drop your bow on the ground, have the ally with the Glaive cast Draconic Elemental Weapon on it, then pick it up. Every arrow gets +1 to hit and +1d4 damage, once per long rest. Pick Thunder: few enemies resist it, and your Caustic Band and Flawed Helldusk Gloves already add acid and fire. Sold by Roah Moonglow at Moonrise Towers.
Melee attackers that damage you take 1d4 acid. Always on, but it only matters when enemies reach you: wear it if they keep doing so. In a gilded chest above the pit in Reithwin.
